description: This file defines a PHP class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Strict that extends another class and customizes certain methods and properties for strict HTML Tidy configurations within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Strict
classes.description: A class for defining strict Tidy HTML configurations, extending functionality from HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_XHTMLAndHTML4, and customizing fixes and child element definitions.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to add or modify specific fixes related to blockquote content model type.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Returns a specialized child definition object for strict blockquote content model type, or delegates to the parent implementation.
